**VP of Analytics & Insights**
Global Payments Inc.
Chicago, IL (Hybrid)

Global Payments is seeking a VP of Analytics & Insights to lead our data analytics function and drive strategic decision-making across the organization.

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead 25-person analytics team covering descriptive, predictive, and prescriptive analytics
- Develop and execute enterprise analytics strategy aligned with business objectives
- Build advanced analytics and ML capabilities for fraud detection, customer analytics, and pricing
- Manage relationships with key business stakeholders including CFO and CTO
- Drive data democratization initiatives including self-service analytics
- Own analytics P&L of $5M+

Qualifications:
- 10+ years in data analytics with 5+ years in VP/Director level roles
- Financial services/payments industry experience preferred
- Strong technical foundation in Python, SQL, and ML
- Experience with Snowflake, Tableau, and cloud platforms
- MBA from top-tier program preferred

Salary: $275,000 - $330,000/year
Benefits: Full benefits, 401k match, equity

Apply at: https://careers.globalpayments.com/vp-analytics-2026
